items.title: US credit card debt hits record $1.29 trillion in third quarter
items.summary: Investing.com -- Credit card balances in the United States rose by $22 billion in the third quarter to reach a record $1.29 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt report released today. The balances increased 4.2% compared to the same period last year.

items.title: Visa (V) Stock Could Be Reasonable With Excess Returns Intact
items.summary: Visa has delivered strong long term gains for shareholders, which puts a spotlight on whether the current share price is properly supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. With the stock now reflecting years of compounding performance and a growing role in global payments, the question is how much of those capital returns are already embedded in today’s valuation. items.title: PayPal’s (PYPL) Turnaround Still Needs Proof

PayPal Holdings operates a global digital-payments network spanning its PayPal and Venmo wallets, branded checkout, Braintree payment processing, credit products, and other merchant services.
